The latest trades from Rulli show the sale of Wells Fargo and Microsoft and the purchase of Goldman Sachs.

Normally this wouldn’t be too much to look at, but the fact that Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo both report quarterly financial results on Oct. 13 is interesting. The congressman could be betting on a strong report from Goldman Sachs, with shares down 1.9% year-to-date in 2026.
Goldman Sachs to report earnings per share of $14.31, up from $12.25 year-over-year. The company has beaten analyst estimates for earnings per share in six straight quarters.

Analysts expect Goldman Sachs to report third-quarter revenue of $16.98 billion, up from $15.18 billion. The company has beaten analyst estimates for revenue in two straight quarters and five of the last six quarters overall.

The congressman is one of the smaller traders in Congress with 38 trades worth around $371,000, according to data from Quiver Quantitative.
While he has a limited trading history, Benzinga previously flagged that Rulli disclosed 32 stock trades, with some reported years after they were made, violating the STOCK Act.
Rulli took office in 2024 and is worth $27 million, according to data from Quiver Quantitative.
